top_signals.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 28
top_signals.summary: Oil pushed higher as Iran and the US appeared far apart on a new ceasefire deal for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, with Tehran saying it’s sticking to a proposal that US President Donald Trump has rejected.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
top_signals.summary: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Citi Recommends Buying China’s 30-Year Bonds on Weak Growth View
top_signals.summary: Citigroup Inc. is advising investors to buy 30-year Chinese government bonds as it expects lingering weakness in the economy and tapering supply of longer-term debt to boost demand for the paper.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Markets Pricing for Long-Term Uncertainty: WisdomTree's Gupta
top_signals.summary: Aneeka Gupta, WisdomTree Director of Macroeconomic Research, joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss expectations for higher and prolonged uncertainty reflected in the bond market.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Crypto-friendly institution Franklin Templeton brings its tokenized collateral service to Bybit
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: PB Fintech’s $3.3 Billion Rout Fuels Rush to Leveraged Bets
top_signals.summary: Traders piled into leveraged bets on Temasek-backed PB Fintech Ltd. as the stock lost $3.3 billion in market value on Thursday after India’s insurance regulator proposed caps on commissions and management expenses.
